digest.component_or_area: blame.py caused-by derivation and ticket reference resolution
propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits 'Ambiguous prefix' errors on stderr for unrelated bare 4-hex commit subjects and then hangs for minutes after the close commits durably

The blame module re-resolves the bug_id on every commit in the branch history without caching or quiet resolution, causing an O(commits × tickets) alias scan that costs ~9 minutes on the measured checkout

Four changes fix the defect: pass quiet=True at all scanner call sites, hoist bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop, memoize ref-to-resolution within a derivation, and short-circuit on hex-quad shape before touching the store
Documentation must stop advertising bare 4-digit references and instead name preferred forms: alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full canonical id, and Jira/bridge ids
